items.note: The prompt never says the product is a B2B note-taking app.
The prompt doesn't name the readers (engineering and design leads) or say the PRD is for a kickoff.
The prompt doesn't define the v1 scope: creating a workspace, inviting members by email, and shared notes.
The prompt doesn't say v1 has only two roles, admin and member.
The prompt doesn't list the out-of-scope items: billing changes, SSO and guest access.
The prompt doesn't give the success metric (20% of paid accounts create a workspace within 60 days).
The prompt sets no length limit (about 2 pages at most).
The prompt doesn't say to leave migration of existing shared notes as an open question.
